close_reason: Test now uses non-empty known set, properly testing the real boundary
description: check_known_capabilities_empty_using_is_ok passes known:&[] (empty). The real boundary case is empty using[] against a non-empty known set — that should also return Ok. The test as written doesn't distinguish between 'correctly returns Ok for empty using' and 'loop never executes so we never reach the contains check'. A client could break this invariant — e.g., if the implementation were changed to require at least one declared capability — and this test would not catch it.
title: empty-using test uses empty known set — vacuously true, misses real boundary
